TRACTION CONTROL SYSTEM (TCL) DIAGNOSIS
TSB Revision
TRACTION CONTROL SYSTEM (TCL)
35C-29
INSPECTION PROCEDURE 4: The TCL Indicator Light Remains Illuminated after the Engine is 
Started.
NOTE: This diagnosis procedure is limited to cases where communication with the scan tool is possible 
(ABS-ECU power supply is normal) and no diagnostic trouble code outputs.
NOTE: CONNECTOR LOCK SWITCH
ON: The ABS-ECU connector A-02 is connected.
OFF: The ABS-ECU connector A-02 is disconnected.
TCL Warning Light and TCL Indicator Light Circuit
